title: DPOK: Reinforcement Learning for Fine-tuning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

layout.note: Two panels side by side with serif captions underneath: (a) stacks a dataset frame, a reward box and a left-to-right model chain; (b) is a column of three identical rounds, each a row of model, image and reward box, joined by hollow arrows.

lesson: To contrast offline and online training, redraw the same three boxes (model, samples, reward) in two panels with identical colours per role and change only where the samples come from: one fixed grid of thumbnails in (a) versus one fresh sample per round in (b), with hollow block arrows labelled Model update between rounds.
